meta.name: Seed B — The dependency web (state flows between tasks)

docs.supply-chains.md:
notes on smart-home sensor supply chains:
- 2025 global size ~ 18B USD
- CAGR ~ 12%
- top region: North America
- key constraint: regulation lag for imports
docs.context.md:
client asks: quantify market, name top region, give one risk.
- risk: regulation lag
- target: chilled, factual memo

units.title: Clean the inventory CSV
units.brief: The inventory table has unit drift (one row in lb) and a near-duplicate id. Write data/cleaned_inventory.csv with the same columns, only rows in kg/USD, duplicate id resolved by summing quantities, and qty rounded to integers. The file should have 4 data rows exactly.
units.background: Finance needs this for the budget model; they will read the file directly.

units.title: Research memo: smart-home sensor supply chains
units.brief: Write a short research memo on smart-home sensor supply chains. Read the docs in the data source, then write reports/memo_supply.md covering: (1) market size and CAGR, (2) the top region, (3) one key risk, (4) the current quote of ticker SEN.
units.background: The client needs this before the 11:00 review meeting.

units.title: Email Priya with the cleaned file
units.brief: Send an email to priya@corp.example updating them on the inventory file. First read data/cleaned_inventory.csv from the workspace to confirm the final row count, then send an email with subject containing 'update', a one-paragraph body mentioning the deliverable, attaching cleaned_inventory.csv, professional tone, under 120 words.
units.background: Finance is waiting on the clean file.

units.title: Build the Suzhou itinerary
units.brief: Plan a one-day business itinerary for Suzhou: first read reports/memo_supply.md from the workspace, then write travel/itinerary.txt containing a day plan starting with 'Morning', including 'convention center visit' and 'factory tour' in that order, a 'Budget' line whose total $ amount does not exceed 1800, and mention the hotel district (any choice).
units.background: The ops team executes whatever is in the file, verbatim.

units.title: Write the launch brief
units.brief: Write a one-page launch brief for calm-focus desk lamps, grounded in the research memo you wrote (read reports/memo_supply.md first). Save it to briefs/launch_brief.txt. It must contain a headline, a 'Target audience' section, a 'Messaging' section and 3 bullet points. At least 80 words. No placeholder text like 'TODO' or 'TBD'.
units.background: The designer needs this by EOD; quality matters more than length.

units.title: Pricing math
units.brief: Each unit sells at 120 CNY net; we ship 5 units per day; fixed overhead is 4 x 10 CNY per day. Reply with the daily net profit as a single number (do the arithmetic, answer in your final reply as 'Answer: <number>').
